name: Trusted-forwarder open relay approval drain
summary: Forwarder 0x26bbc304 appended any caller-claimed sender to caller-supplied calldata and called the target without checking a signature or the caller. Executor 0xa152 trusted it as its ERC-2771 forwarder, so anyone could act as any user who had approved the executor's AllowanceTarget and have that user's tokens pulled and swapped to themselves.
notes: Implementation 0xc5107fc8, installed for selector 0xaced3248 in the reset tx, hardcodes the forwarder as trusted, which made its unauthenticated claimed-sender path usable against standing AllowanceTarget approvals.
Anchor: c0ffeebabe.eth's bot relayed a request as wallet 0x67e79574 one day after the reset, pulling its 25.17 USDC and keeping the swap output; the 2026 drain (0x57709a49) and six copycats followed.
Loss is the gross debit of the approval holders at DefiLlama prices (aUSDT at its USDT mark); the attacker realised 229,030.97 USDT from the main drain.
